intro: Kargal Battlescar is a veteran orc warrior stationed at the Far Watch Post along the eastern border of the Barrens. Tasked with guarding the crossing from Durotar, he evaluates incoming recruits and directs capable fighters deeper into the territory to bolster Horde defenses.

p: Standing watch at the Far Watch Post, Kargal Battlescar oversees the strategic threshold separating the harsh red plains of Durotar from the vast savanna of the Barrens. As travelers and fresh adventurers cross the bridge over the Southfury River, Kargal ensures they understand that the peaceful days of training in the Valley of Trials are over. The Barrens is a contested and dangerous expanse, plagued by aggressive wildlife, centaur raiding parties, and quilboar tribes. Kargal inspects those who pass, mustering willing recruits into the service of the Horde and sending them onward to the Crossroads to aid local commanders in securing the frontier.
